# Donkey Ideas - Full Documentation

> Donkey Ideas is a comprehensive venture builder platform and operating system that helps entrepreneurs build, manage, and scale ventures from idea to exit.

## Company Overview
Donkey Ideas is a venture builder and operating system designed for entrepreneurs, startup founders, and venture builders. The platform consolidates financial management, project tracking, analytics, pitch decks, whitepapers, team management, and AI-powered insights into a single unified dashboard.

## Platform Features

### Financial Management
- **P&L Statements**: Track revenue (product, service, other) and expenses (direct costs, infrastructure, sales/marketing, R&D, admin) by period
- **Balance Sheets**: Monitor assets (cash, receivables, fixed assets) and liabilities (payables, short-term and long-term debt)
- **Cash Flow Analysis**: Operating, investing, and financing cash flows with beginning/ending balances
- **Budget & Forecast**: Category-based budgeting with income/expense tracking, period management (monthly/quarterly), and budget vs actuals comparison
- **Consolidated View**: Multi-company financial aggregation with intercompany transaction handling

### Analytics & Intelligence
- **Google Analytics Integration**: Real GA4 data including sessions, pageviews, bounce rate, traffic sources, top pages, and device breakdown
- **AI-Powered Recommendations**: DeepSeek-driven analytics insights with daily cached recommendations including pros, cons, and actionable suggestions
- **Consolidated Analytics**: Portfolio-wide analytics aggregation across all companies
- **SEO & GEO Analytics**: Search engine optimization and generative engine optimization monitoring

### Venture Management
- **Business Profile**: Mission, target market, competitive advantage, key achievements, and operational metrics
- **Valuation Engine**: Multiple valuation methods (revenue multiples, DCF, market comparables) with AI scoring
- **Project Management**: Kanban-style boards with columns and cards, drag-and-drop task management
- **Document Library**: Version-controlled document storage with file type support

### Content & Communications
- **Pitch Deck Builder**: AI-generated investor, sales, and partnership presentations with slide-by-slide editing
- **Whitepaper Generator**: Comprehensive business documentation including executive summary, technology stack, market analysis, financial projections, and roadmap
- **Website Manager**: CMS for managing public website content, SEO settings, and domain configuration
- **Contact Management**: Form submission tracking with read/unread status

### Team & Access
- **Team Management**: Role-based access (owner, admin, member, viewer) with granular permissions
- **Investor Portal**: Investor access management with investment tracking and update notifications
- **Activity Logs**: Comprehensive audit trail of all actions across the platform
- **Two-Factor Authentication**: TOTP-based 2FA support for enhanced security

### AI Integration
- **AI Assistant**: Conversational AI for business guidance, analysis, and strategic planning
- **Multiple AI Providers**: Support for DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google AI APIs
- **Smart Recommendations**: AI-driven insights across analytics, financials, and business strategy

## Technology
- Built with Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
- PostgreSQL database with Prisma ORM
- Real-time Google Analytics Data API integration
- Multi-theme support (dark, light, blue)
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile

## Target Audience
- Entrepreneurs and startup founders
- Venture builders managing multiple companies
- Small business owners seeking comprehensive management tools
- Investors looking for portfolio oversight capabilities
